data.title: bn-30fs exact execution-authority review f0ac22ef
data.description: Independent risk-high static review of exact commit f0ac22ef8d2268a372724a5e3d2f4083d22395b7 tree 8156e2bcb703e40bf050f43d07ccca4c6f271301. Scope: retained execution authority, descriptor/bwrap bindings, lock-authority cross-binding, Git/nm/Python authority, full toolchain pre/post evidence, failure normalization, manifest integrity, and validator adequacy. No Cargo/rustc/product/build/child/network/security-tool execution.

data.body: HIGH: Preserved non-config CARGO_HOME directories are descriptor-selected only at their top level, so their recursively consumed build inputs are neither frozen nor attested. _capture_directory stores a BoundBuildDirectory for entries such as registry/git, but BoundBuildDirectory.verify compares only device/type/inode/permissions (lines 2058-2064), not contents or even pre/post directory timestamps; prepare_bwrap_args then mounts that live directory with --ro-bind-fd. A host-side edit/replacement below registry or git remains visible inside the nominally read-only guest mount and is accepted by replay/exit. Safe static probe evidence on this exact commit: changed cargo-home/registry/src/reviewed-crate/lib.rs while the guard was active; guard_replay_equal=true and exit_accepted=true. This can change dependency/build-script bytes used by the fresh Cargo build without changing the lock, config evidence, toolchain manifest, or final attestation. The frozen Cargo.lock includes 364 registry sources plus git dependency ident, so lock resolution is not a substitute for binding the actual cached source closure; the git entry has no registry checksum, and no reviewed contract proves Cargo checksum behavior closes concurrent source mutation. The validator also misses this: self_test_cargo_config_guard creates an empty registry and only checks bind-argument counts, while hostile mutations cover top-level selection but no nested-content edit. Please stage or recursively pre/post manifest the exact CARGO_HOME dependency closure (with descriptor-bound selection and attested digest), reject any nested change across each build, and add a hostile nested mutation test.

data.reason: HIGH th-2o6gyy: the read-only guest CARGO_HOME still consumes live, recursively mutable registry/git directory contents that are not included in any pre/post manifest; a safe exact-commit probe changed nested dependency bytes and both replay and guard exit accepted it. Exact build-input authority and validator coverage are therefore incomplete.
